summaryEn: Musk talks about his life, Tesla, SpaceX and his ambition to colonize Mars in a profile interview.
summaryZh: 在这次人物专访中，马斯克谈到自己的生活、Tesla、SpaceX，以及殖民火星的抱负。

segments.textEn: The story of Elon Musk is almost too incredible to believe. He's an engineer and entrepreneur worth more than $15 billion. He backs himself on high-risk ventures, which invariably lead to huge profits. First, there was PayPal, the way to buy and sell on the internet. Then Tesla, the electric supercar he built, and SpaceX, the rocket company NASA uses. Now, his sights are set even further a field, colonizing Mars.
